name: AzCmply custom controls
note: Controls by JSolve B.V. for Azure attack paths and risks that none of the other frameworks covers, based on published attack research and breaches. Each control is checked by the tests listed with it.

AZC-01.title: Network rules do not trust addresses that other Azure customers share

AZC-02.title: No access path bypasses the network controls of a workload (deployment sites, Bastion shareable links, serial console)

AZC-03.title: Managed identities have no rights beyond the resource group of their resource

AZC-04.title: Groups with privileged Azure access can only be changed by privileged administrators

AZC-05.title: Data roles are granted on the resources that hold the data, not on subscriptions or above

AZC-06.title: Storage firewalls only admit resources of the own tenant

AZC-07.title: Published APIs authenticate every caller with a subscription key or a validated token

AZC-08.title: Unexpected cost reaches the owners of a subscription

AZC-09.title: Takeover actions raise an alert that nothing silences (role assignments, removed locks, run command)

AZC-10.title: Only Tier 0 administrators can take over domain controllers through Azure (virtual machines and Arc-enabled servers)

AZC-11.title: Workloads that anyone can call have no write access in Azure

AZC-12.title: Workflows do not keep failing unnoticed

AZC-13.title: Only those who can change a function app can change the storage it runs from

AZC-14.title: Only the administrators of a machine can change the code that Automation runs on it

AZC-15.title: Roles that run code on machines are granted on the machines, not on subscriptions or above

AZC-16.title: Role assignments do not repeat access that a broader assignment of the same principal already grants

AZC-17.title: Nobody can act through a managed identity with more rights than their own (custom policy definitions, user-assigned identities)

AZC-18.title: Machine images and registry artifacts cannot be shared or exported out of the tenant

AZC-19.title: Servers connected with Azure Arc only run approved extensions

AZC-20.title: Virtual desktops do not move files or clipboard contents to the local device

AZC-21.title: URLs that start runbooks without signing in expire within a year

AZC-22.title: Only designated users can create Microsoft Entra tenants
